name: @intent-wallet/compliance
description: Compliance & Governance engine — a policy-driven, jurisdiction-configurable authorization + governance layer kept OUTSIDE core wallet logic. Jurisdiction rules are versioned DATA (never hardcoded country rules): feature availability, consent, data retention, reporting obligations, screening + risk thresholds. A deterministic Compliance Gateway evaluates each action (fail-closed, most-restrictive) and emits obligations; plus consent, retention/DSAR (erasure reconciled against legal holds), RBAC + approval workflows + emergency controls + feature flags, a tamper-evident hash-chained audit log, and deterministic reporting. It gates and audits; it never holds keys or moves funds — the wallet stays non-custodial.
